notes.title: Custom Mode Major Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

I'm excited to annouce that a major update for the game is now live!



This update includes:

Custom mode is now polished and available in the base game. 

When reaching the end of the wave, all basic keys can be destroyed with one click.

Cleaning up and polishing.



Custom mode gives you the freedom to modify your runs to your taste. It gives you a granular level of settings and options.



Whether you need to explore specific key mechanics or create a new run, the custom mode will give you that!



Here are some screenshots for the editor:


The basic setting of the run:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567502/cc44b76ab06425884497542c95a225a5623d6053.png"]


The event setting of the run:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567502/946bb8edd2b98f92d7a9fb2496a644d42f308438.png"]


A curve-based logic, to have fine control for spawn settings:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567502/9df66242a393c95f7f7dbe9e8f2a466cf89d8805.png"]


You can go crazy with it, like:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567502/c187b45e10d75b16dff97af8b1b9e9cf61674f55.png"]

or
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567502/dcb6cfdb19a42a5d472b99ae9eac3889b5630ebc.png"]



Hope you enjoy it!
-Ali.

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.0.8.0
notes.notes:
Added a new treasure loot box, which gives an upgrade point or coins when destroyed. It spawns rarely or under certain conditions.

Game balancing.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567502/ffdd5bf8d77bf76dc7d7a4e877cae2b92edb2401.gif"]

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.0.7.0
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where the achievement Outbreak! doesn't work if you destroy a previously infected key.

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.0.6.0
notes.notes: Made the Outbreak! achievement required only 6 infected keys instead of 10. Making it easier to achieve.

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.0.5.0
notes.notes:
Made level 4 slightly easier.
 Added 3 more cursor customizations.
 Some minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.0.4.2
notes.notes:
Warden can be destroyed slightly faster.
 Basic keys can be destroyed slightly faster in early levels.
 Fixed some visual issues.
 Level 0: Increased spawn rate and health for basic keys in level 0, and now you start with 5 extra upgrade points.

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.0.4.0
notes.notes: Fixed language doesn't save after quitting the game, thanks to weedhonk for reporting this issue.

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.0.3.2
notes.notes:
Fixed some sounds still playing while the master volume is set to 0
 Fixed audio slider isn't updating correctly when opening the menu for the first time
 More small gameplay balancing.


Thanks to 夕凪メロン for pointing out the audio issues. More info:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/3614980/discussions/0/603036969475447320/

notes.title: Upadte Notes for Version 1.0.3.0
notes.notes:
Added key info box, now the players can either explore by themselves, or return to the main menu and understand the key's mechanic better. This will help in case of forgetting or skipping the tutorial by mistake. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567502/8968f5ec5b34c4094a3ff718ff29f01b38ffae4c.gif"]

Reduced the last special key (on level 10) health by 5%.

Some QoL improvements.

notes.title: Update Notes for version 1.0.2.0
notes.notes:
Minor balancing, later levels are slightly easier.
 Added visual UI to indicate the keyboard numbers corresponding to the order in the toolbar
 Some minor visual upgrades.
